verdict.rationale: Vanta documents its own API for getting data out: it can list documents, policies, and evidence (vanta-docs-1) and pull controls, evidence, and audit resources (vanta-docs-29). Its marketing also says the API can programmatically extract information from Vanta (vanta-docs-24). This is a real extraction path, but nothing shows a dedicated full-account export, open-format guarantees, or offboarding support, and no published OpenAPI spec was found (vanta-probe-3). Missing for 10: documented bulk or complete data export, explicit open formats (e.g. CSV/JSON archives of all evidence and policies), offboarding/data-portability documentation, independent corroboration.
